# Dry Powder

> Open, risk-first perpetuals on Arc Testnet (chain 5042002, USDC gas), built for people and AI agents. One USDC
> vault is the counterparty to every trade at the oracle price. Up to 5000x in Turbo markets (no fee unless you
> win); above 100x, and in every Turbo market, trades fill only through keeper orders. You can never lose more
> than margin plus fees.

## Rules
- Markets (v3.2): EUR-USD-TURBO 5000x, XAU-USD-TURBO 2500x, BTC-USD-TURBO and ETH-USD-TURBO 1000x; BTC-USD and ETH-USD 1000x; SOL-USD, EUR-USD and XAU-USD 500x; the dated BTC future 250x; JPY-USD and ETH-BTC 100x.
- Turbo (fee mode Upside): no open or close fee; the house keeps 20% of a winning close's profit (19% with a referrer); fills at the oracle mid both ways; keeper orders only (direct calls revert OrdersOnly). Standard markets: 5 bp of size plus a skew surcharge, each side capped at 10% of margin.
- Above 100x or in Turbo: open with PerpEngine.createLimitOrder (marketable trigger = market order) or createLimitOrderUntil(params, expiresAt); close with setTriggerOrder(marketId, 3, worstPrice, size) (size 0 = all). openPosition/closePosition revert HighLeverageNeedsOrder above 100x.
- Liquidation when losses plus funding reach 90% of margin (a 0.018% move at 5000x). Profit capped at 10x margin.
- Units: USDC 6 decimals; prices 18 decimals. One position per market per trader: an open on the same side adds to it, the other side reverts PositionExists.
- Manage: closePosition(marketId, size, acceptablePrice, priceUpdate) closes all or part; setTriggerOrder(marketId, 1|2, price, size) for sized take-profit/stop-loss; addMargin(marketId, amount) (not while in profit); removeMargin(marketId, amount, priceUpdate) (never profit, at most 100x after); setOrderExpiry(orderId, expiresAt); cancelExpired(ids) pays the caller each expired order's execution fee; LimitParams.stopEntry = true for breakout entries; AgentAccount.multicall for atomic batches.
- Referrals: setReferrer(referrer) once per account: 5% off every fee, 10% of each fee to the referrer, collected with claim().
- Add-ons for agent accounts (approve each as an agent; the keeper pokes them): Strategies (trend, mean-reversion and copy strategies run on-chain), TrailingStops.setTrail(account, marketId, distanceBps, size, activation), TwapOrders.setTwap(account, marketId, isLong, sliceMargin, sliceSize, slices, interval, maxSlippageBps). Agent keys can carry a daily spending budget. AgentRegistry lists agents publicly.
- Collateral on testnet is tUSDC (anyone may mint up to 1,000,000 per call); gas is native USDC from https://faucet.circle.com.

## Addresses
- [Live deployment JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/main/deployments/arc-testnet.json): engine (one address, union ABI of PerpEngine and PerpEngineExt), lens, vault, token, usdc, agentFactory, trailingStops, twapOrders, strategies, agentRegistry, prizeDistributor, markets.
- RPC: https://rpc.testnet.arc.io (fallbacks: rpc.quicknode.testnet.arc.io, rpc.drpc.testnet.arc.io, rpc.blockdaemon.testnet.arc.io). Explorer: https://explorer.testnet.arc.io

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how agents trade, which orders to use, the worst-case check before every trade.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/tree/main/sdk): DryPowder.connect, quote (worst case first, Turbo-aware), open (with expiry), close (all or part), setStops, addMargin, removeMargin, scale, closeAll, cancelAll, referrals, agent accounts with daily budgets, strategies, the registry, prizes, typed errors, pure risk maths.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/tree/main/mcp): tools dp_markets, dp_quote, dp_open, dp_limit, dp_close, dp_set_tpsl, dp_add_margin, dp_remove_margin, dp_order_expiry, dp_cancel, dp_referral, dp_set_referrer, dp_claim, dp_strategies, dp_strategy_create, dp_strategy_control, dp_agents, dp_prepare_owner_tx, dp_account, dp_faucet.
- [Examples](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/tree/main/examples): quickstart, risk-capped agent, swarm, a Turbo trade with a stop, a strategy launcher.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Venue stats (JSON, every 5 minutes)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/status/status/stats.json): per-trader and per-market totals, funding and open-interest history.
